scripts.lint:ci: bun run lint:no-long-dashes && ultracite check --max-warnings 0 --format github
scripts.test: bun run test:install && turbo run //#test:root && turbo run test --concurrency=2
scripts.test:root: vitest run lint scripts stacks --exclude scripts/check-patches.test.ts
scripts.sandbox:plan: bun run secrets:run sandbox -- bun alchemy deploy alchemy.sandbox.ts --stage sandbox --dry-run --no-input
scripts.sandbox:apply: bun run secrets:run sandbox -- bun alchemy deploy alchemy.sandbox.ts --stage sandbox --no-input --yes
scripts.ci: bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.ios:release: bun run secrets:run apple -- bun run --cwd apps/mobile ios:release
scripts.ios:update: bun run secrets:run mobile-updates -- bun apps/mobile/scripts/updates/publish.ts
scripts.deploy:staging: bun run secrets:run preview -- bun alchemy deploy --stage staging
scripts.deploy:production: bun run secrets:run production -- bun alchemy deploy --stage prod
scripts.infra:plan: bun scripts/secrets/infra.ts bun alchemy deploy alchemy.ci.ts --stage ci --dry-run --detect-drift --no-input
scripts.infra:deploy: bun scripts/secrets/infra.ts bun alchemy deploy alchemy.ci.ts --stage ci
scripts.posthog:plan: bun run secrets:run posthog -- env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=984b82870acd18daf8bda97bad966b38 bun alchemy deploy alchemy.posthog.ts --stage prod --dry-run
scripts.posthog:deploy: bun run secrets:run posthog -- env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=984b82870acd18daf8bda97bad966b38 bun alchemy deploy alchemy.posthog.ts --stage prod
scripts.db:rehearse: bun run secrets:run recovery -- bun run scripts/database/migrate-from-postgres.ts --local
scripts.setup:infisical: bun alchemy profile edit --add Infisical --method universal-auth --set clientId=env:INFISICAL_CLIENT_ID --set clientSecret=env:INFISICAL_CLIENT_SECRET --no-input
scripts.secrets:plan:preview: bun alchemy deploy alchemy.secrets.ts --stage preview --profile admin --dry-run --no-input
scripts.secrets:plan:production: bun alchemy deploy alchemy.secrets.ts --stage prod --profile admin --dry-run --no-input
scripts.secrets:deploy:preview: bun alchemy deploy alchemy.secrets.ts --stage preview --profile admin
scripts.secrets:deploy:production: bun alchemy deploy alchemy.secrets.ts --stage prod --profile admin
